where.if: AND ( e.EMP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp ( EMP_ID, EMP_NAME, EMAIL, DEPT_ID, JOB_CODE, SALARY, HIRE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{empId}, #{empName}, #{email}, #{deptId}, #{jobCode}, #{salary}, #{hireDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT EMP_ID AS empId, EMP_NAME AS empName, EMAIL AS email, DEPT_ID AS deptId, JOB_CODE AS jobCode, SALARY AS salary, HIRE_DATE AS hireDate, PHONE AS phone, ENT_YN AS entYn FROM emp WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId}
